current_assessment.scope: The #1790 comparison of the same undrawn right triangle across conditional, structural, powers-based and intellectual accounts of real possibility.
current_assessment.assessment: The Euclidean construction fixes the third side at 5. A structural account and an intellectual account both use orthogonality to explain that result, and the calculation needs no additional premise about a thinker. Abstract realism can grant an actual basis for mathematical content. Exact concrete configurability and the indispensable contribution of a particular intellect remain separate questions. Even a ground in every world would leave its identity across worlds open.
current_assessment.next_test: Seek independently warranted properties of a concrete system sufficient for this exact configuration, or identify an intrinsic contribution of a specified intellect indispensable to the metric constraints themselves. Repeating the side calculation cannot decide either question.
